headlines.text: Looking back to 2021, when Hikaru Shida vs. Ryo Mizunami clashed for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.08 ? a real highlight of the night. It was the first title opportunity of Ryo Mizunami's career. A grudge match capping years of previous three-way draws between the two ? Mizunami had personally guaranteed Shida wouldn't beat her "even in 100 years," but the champion proved her wrong with a hard-earned corkscrew knee finish in a match many called a career-best outing for both.
Looking back to 2026, when Lena Kross arrived in AEW, appearing on Collision, rated 6.97.

On a Sunday in 2021, back when Sting made their AEW debut in a Street Fight match against Allin & Team Taz (Cage & Starks), appearing on Revolution, rated 7.81 ? a well-worked match. Sting's first in-ring match in over five years since his forced retirement, teaming with Darby Allin in a cinematic street fight ? a career comeback nobody thought they'd see, and one Sting himself later said meant more to him than Allin ever realized.

Looking back to 2021, when Colten Gunn made their AEW debut in a Casino Battle Royale match, appearing on Revolution, rated 6.05.
